etymology: From “nut” in the American sense: cherry picking the most extreme case and calling it the group.
committed_when: A group's worst member is easier to find than its actual position.
tell: The reply is a screenshot of someone unrepresentative, presented as the movement's face.
counter: Ask whether the case is typical, and who speaks for the group. If nobody does, the loudest member is a poor proxy.
senses: Judging a movement by its worst adherents, or defending it by its most reasonable ones.
It works because the extreme case is vivid and the movement is large. Any sizeable group contains someone who will embarrass it, so the example is always available and never representative.
example: “Look at this comment, this is what they all think.” One comment, four hundred thousand readers, no survey.

confused_with.tell: Nut-picking is cherry picking where the cherries are people, chosen for being the worst available.
